headline: Week 7: Robinson is out and Breece Hall is a game-time call, so add Kendre Miller before 6:30 AM Pacific and a kicker before 10:00 AM Pacific.
alerts: Brian Robinson (hamstring) is OUT. Remove him from your lineup.
Kendre Miller (NO) locks at 6:30 AM Pacific in Paris. Add him now for RB2 if he is still free. Drop McLaurin or Keaton Mitchell.
You still have no kicker. Add Jake Bates or Chad Ryland before Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, or the K slot scores zero.
Breece Hall is questionable (quad). Jets inactives post about 8:30 AM Pacific for the 10:00 AM kickoff. If he is out, swap in Miller or Lloyd.
Hockenson and Jefferson have no designation and will play. Colts TE Tyler Warren and CB Sauce Gardner are out, a boost for Downs and Jefferson.
Golden (shoulder) was limited all week but has no designation. Jacobs is on track to play, so Lloyd is only a fill-in.
Sleeper could not be reached again this run, so the roster is from an earlier run. Confirm your waiver claims and lineup in the app.

ARI.note: At Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Broncos -4 to -4.5, total 43.5. RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) out, QB2 Carson Beck questionable.

GB.note: At Detroit Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Lions -3 to -3.5, total 53.5. Jacobs on track to play, Golden and Watson limited all week but no designation, Love full Friday.

DET.note: Vs. Green Bay Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. About 28 implied. C Cade Mays and DB Brian Branch questionable.

ATL.note: Vs. San Francisco Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. 49ers -3.5 to -4, total 50.5 to 51. Brian Robinson out.

MIN.note: Vs. Indianapolis Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Vikings -5 to -6.5, total 41.5. Jefferson, Hockenson, Addison no designation. Jordan Mason questionable but trending up.

IND.note: At Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Warren, Gould and Gardner all out.

NYJ.note: Vs. Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jets -4.5, total 38.5 to 39.5. Breece Hall questionable, limited Thursday and Friday.

DAL.note: At Philadelphia Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Cowboys -4 to -4.5, total 44.5. Pickens full Friday.

PHI.note: Vs. Dallas Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Barkley (hamstring) limited Friday and leaning toward playing. DeVonta Smith and Goedert did not practice Friday.

NO.note: Vs. Pittsburgh in Paris Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific, the earliest lock of the week. Steelers -2 to -3.5, total 44.5.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: At Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Broncos -4 to -4.5, total 43.5, Arizona about 19.5 implied.
RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is out again, so the offense leans on the pass. Backup QB Carson Beck (back) is questionable.
Only healthy QB on the roster with Hurts on IR, so he starts by default.
